description: Defines an enum ConditionVerificationStatus representing verification statuses for a medical condition, with related documentation and status values.

classes.name: ConditionVerificationStatus
classes.description: An enum representing verification status of a medical condition, including options like PROVISIONAL and CONFIRMED.

methods.name: PROVISIONAL
methods.description: Indicates a tentative diagnosis that is under consideration, previously called 'Presumed'.

methods.name: CONFIRMED
methods.description: Indicates sufficient diagnostic or clinical evidence for a confirmed condition.
